articles.summary: Beat the Heat with a Cool Deal: Caesars Entertainment Presents Caesars Show Week from June 22-29 With more than 160 shows available at Caesars Entertainment resorts across the country, please visit Ticketmaster.com/Caesars50 for more info and to purchase LAS VEGAS (June 22, 2026) Caesars Entertainment is inviting guests to celebrate the summer with live entertainment deals at more than 25 destinations across the U.S, including Las Vegas, Atlantic City and Lake Tahoe. Caesars Show Week, running June 22-29, features $50 tickets, with select shows offering two tickets for $50 (plus service fee and tax). The limited-time offer includes superstar headliners to the biggest names in comedy and magic. Resorts participating in "Caesars Show Week" include: Caesars Palace Las Vegas Flamingo Las Vegas Harrahs Las Vegas Horseshoe Las Vegas The LINQ Hotel The LINQ Promenade Paris Las Vegas Planet Hollywood Resort

articles.summary: Expanded partnership builds on sports wagering collaboration and positions Caesars and its tribal partners for future online casino launch Caesars Entertainment, Inc. (NASDAQ: CZR) (“Caesars”) today announced the expansion of its existing partnership with three Wabanaki Nations: the Houlton Band of Maliseet Indians, the Mi’kmaq Nation and the Penobscot Nation, to include online casino gaming in Maine. The long-term agreement positions Caesars and its tribal partners for a potential iGaming launch in the state in 2026, pending regulatory approvals. Under the expanded agreement, Caesars plans to bring a portfolio of three online casino brands to Maine: Caesars Palace Online Casino, Caesars Sportsbook Casino and Horseshoe Online Casino. Each brand offers a distinct digital experience tailored to different player interests. articles.title: Caesars Entertainment and Three Wabanaki Nations Expand Relationship to Include Planned Maine Online Casino Launch
